claim_boundary: T20-C is a conditionally admitted follow-up to the registered T19-C negative. It changes exactly five prespecified things relative to T19-C: the subspace may be learned by interchange optimization on the same source bank; three residual-stream sites join the six component sites; the decision endpoint is gated on the alias-retrieval component alone with a codepoint self-retrieval guard; the evaluation bank is 384 fresh atomic emoji with zero prior T19 or T20 forwards, read in four contexts; and every site carries a full-representation interchange ceiling as a positive control. Training reuses the frozen 128-item T19 causal-source bank. A positive result supports only bounded component-level causal contribution for this cell, rank, and endpoint. A negative result at a site whose ceiling passes bounds rank-8 interchange-learnable subspaces at that site; a negative result at a site whose ceiling fails is recorded as uncalibratable at this endpoint. The result cannot establish rendered-glyph perception, human meaning, a unique or complete circuit, tokenizer independence, pretraining novelty, architecture or model-population generality, a scale law, or natural-language behavior; behavioral endpoints are deliberately out of scope and remain with the T16-OSC record.
